text.hi: बीते समय (past) के वाक्य को सवाल बनाना हो तो शुरू में ‘Did’ लगाओ और काम वाले शब्द को पहले रूप में करो: He had no ticket. → Did he have a ticket? (had → have)
text.hinglish: Beete samay (past) ke vaakya ko sawaal banaana ho to shuru mein ‘Did’ lagao aur kaam waale shabd ko pehle roop mein karo: He had no ticket. → Did he have a ticket? (had → have)
text.en: To turn a past sentence into a question, put ‘Did’ first and use the base form of the verb: He had a ticket. → Did he have a ticket? (had → have)

text.hi: याद रखो: Did के बाद हमेशा सीधा रूप: got → get, lived → live, paid → pay, started → start।
text.hinglish: Yaad rakho: Did ke baad hamesha seedha roop: got → get, lived → live, paid → pay, started → start.
text.en: Remember: after Did, always the base form: got → get, lived → live, paid → pay, started → start.

text.en: Next in the book: rearrange the words to make sentences. Example: Indore / in / lived / Vinod → Vinod lived in Indore.

text.hi: शब्द के आगे re लगाने से मतलब ‘फिर से’ (rewrite = फिर से लिखना)। un लगाने से मतलब ‘नहीं’ (unhappy = ख़ुश नहीं)। पीछे ful लगाने से मतलब ‘भरा हुआ’ (wonderful)।
text.hinglish: Shabd ke aage re lagaane se matlab ‘phir se’ (rewrite = phir se likhna). un lagaane se matlab ‘nahi’ (unhappy = khush nahi). Peechhe ful lagaane se matlab ‘bhara hua’ (wonderful).
text.en: ‘re’ at the start means again (rewrite = write again). ‘un’ means not (unhappy = not happy). ‘ful’ at the end means full of (wonderful = full of wonder).

instruction.hi: नए शब्द को उसके मतलब से जोड़ो (re, un)
instruction.hinglish: Naye shabd ko uske matlab se jodo (re, un)
instruction.en: Join each new word to its meaning (re, un)

instruction.hi: ful वाले शब्द को उसके मतलब से जोड़ो
instruction.hinglish: ful waale shabd ko uske matlab se jodo
instruction.en: Join each -ful word to its meaning
